answer_1.quote: Grammatical Error Correction (GEC) aims to automatically detect and correct the grammatical errors that can be found in a sentence.
answer_1.outputs: corrected sentences with grammatical errors fixed via substitution, deletion, insertion, and local paraphrasing operations

answer_2.quote: Following the typical previous works, we employ sentence-level Accuracy, Precision, Recall, and F1-Measure as the automatic metrics to evaluate the performance of all systems.
